standard.summary: 把 caption 经过文本编码器后的结果提前缓存，训练时直接读取。
standard.effect: 减少文本编码器计算和显存占用，适合 caption 固定的训练。
standard.whenToUse: 不训练文本编码器、caption 不需要每步随机变化时建议开启。
standard.avoidWhen: 开启 shuffle caption、caption dropout、Tag/NL 混合采样或训练文本编码器时要谨慎，通常需要关闭或重建多变体缓存。

standard_en.summary: Caches the text-encoder output for each caption ahead of time, so training reads it directly.
standard_en.effect: Cuts text-encoder computation and VRAM, which suits runs where the captions are fixed.
standard_en.whenToUse: Recommended when you are not training the text encoder and the captions do not need to vary from step to step.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Be careful with shuffle caption, caption dropout, mixed Tag/NL sampling, or text-encoder training -- those usually mean turning it off or building a multi-variant cache.

advanced.principle: 文本编码器输出是条件输入的一部分。缓存它可以把 TE forward 从训练主循环移出。
advanced.intervention: 介入 caption 编码与读取层；对 cache-first 路线，caption 变体需要在缓存生成时固定。
advanced.expectedImpact: 降低 TE 显存与耗时，尤其是 SDXL 双文本编码器和 DiT 文本模型较重时。
advanced.tradeoffs: 会限制训练时动态 caption 策略；改 caption、触发词、dropout 或混合比例后应重建缓存。

advanced_en.principle: Text-encoder output is part of the conditioning input. Caching it moves the TE forward out of the main training loop.
advanced_en.intervention: Intervenes at caption encoding and the read layer; on cache-first routes, caption variants must be fixed at cache-generation time.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Cuts TE VRAM and time, especially with SDXL's dual text encoders or heavy DiT text models.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Restricts dynamic caption strategies during training; rebuild the cache after changing captions, trigger words, dropout, or mix ratios.
